estimand: For this frozen finite benchmark only, the per-run change in objective runtime-mutant item detection when the mechanically extracted public Lua block is added to otherwise identical source/target review input.

outbound_policy.authorization: Permanent project authorization covers sanitized experimental records sent to OpenAI, Anthropic, Z.ai CN/GLM and Google Gemini.

missingness.route_failure: harness failure, not model score; retry identical frozen request only

stopping: Both registered runs are executed exactly once per arm and route. No third run, item replacement, prompt change or outcome-dependent resampling.
result_policy: Preserve every raw envelope, parsed candidate, deterministic score, control-candidate adjudication and final RESULT.json. Separate measured data, derived gates and human interpretation.
